name: Machine stats widget
summary: The vitals of the computer Carnivore runs on as a widget: cpu, memory, disk free, load and uptime, pushed live while it is on screen.
description: At 2 x 2 it stacks three meters (cpu, memory, disk) with bars that turn yellow at 75 percent and coral at 90; at 8 x 2 it draws five columns with load and uptime and a small line under each figure. The figures come from one read of the machine stats route; the server samples only while a visible widget holds a short lease on its sampler and names the machine_stats topic when a figure moves, so a board without the widget costs nothing. A figure that could not be measured says not measured, never zero. Nothing in the answer names the computer or its user.
where: Home screen once added: a cell titled this machine with a chip icon.
The drawer's widget area once added.
how_to: Open the edit layout control at the bottom of the drawer.
Search widgets for machine; press the card to put it on the home page.
Resize it to 2 x 2 for three meters or 8 x 2 for five columns.
examples: Watch cpu and memory climb while several sessions build at once.
Notice disk free on the state volume running low before a save fails.
media_exempt: A widget whose screenshots are captured before the next version bump.
